# momento_custom_role (Resource)

A Custom Role.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Manage a Momento custom role.
# Full permission set example on https://docs.momentohq.com/platform/authentication/roles-http-api#full-permission-set-example:
resource "momento_custom_role" "example" {
  name        = "custom-role-name"
  description = "This is my sample Momento custom role created with Terraform."
  permissions = {
    rules = [
      {
        type        = "account_management",
        permissions = ["read", "list"]
      },
      {
        type        = "auth_management",
        permissions = ["read", "write", "list"],
      items = { all = true } },
      {
        type        = "resource_management",
        permissions = ["read", "write", "list"],
      resources = { all = true } },
      {
        type        = "database",
        permissions = ["read", "write"],
        databases   = { all = true },
      items = { all = true } },
      {
        type        = "database",
        permissions = ["read"],
        databases   = { name = "orders" },
      items = { key_prefix = "orders:2026-" } },
      {
        type        = "database",
        permissions = ["read"],
        databases   = { name = "orders" },
      items = { key = "orders:pending" } },
      {
        type        = "cache",
        permissions = ["read", "write", "list"],
        caches      = { "all" : true },
      items = { all = true } },
      {
        type        = "cache",
        permissions = ["read"],
        caches      = { name = "prod-cache" },
      items = { key_prefix = "public/" } },
      {
        type        = "cache",
        permissions = ["write"],
        caches      = { name = "prod-cache" },
      items = { key = "feature-flags" } },
      {
        type        = "topic",
        permissions = ["read", "write", "list"],
        caches      = { all = true },
      topics = { all = true } },
      {
        type        = "topic",
        permissions = ["read"],
        caches      = { name = "chat-app" },
      topics = { name = "announcements" } },
      {
        type        = "topic",
        permissions = ["write"],
        caches      = { name = "chat-app" },
      topics = { prefix = "room-" } },
      {
        type        = "store",
        permissions = ["read", "write", "list"],
        stores      = { all = true },
      items = { all = true } },
      {
        type        = "store",
        permissions = ["read"],
        stores      = { name = "user-prefs" },
      items = { key_prefix = "org:42:" } },
      {
        type        = "store",
        permissions = ["write"],
        stores      = { name = "user-prefs" },
      items = { key = "schema-version" } },
      {
        type        = "function",
        permissions = ["invoke"],
        caches      = { all = true },
      functions = { all = true } },
      {
        type        = "function",
        permissions = ["invoke"],
        caches      = { name = "edge-app" },
      functions = { name = "resize-image" } },
      {
        type        = "function",
        permissions = ["invoke"],
        caches      = { name = "edge-app" },
      functions = { prefix = "webhook-" } }
    ],
    conditions = [
      {
        ip_filter = {
          allowed_cidr_ranges = [
            "10.0.0.0/8",
            "192.168.1.0/24",
            "2001:db8::/32"
          ]
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the Custom Role.
- `permissions` (Attributes) The permission grant of the Custom Role. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permissions))

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of the Custom Role.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the Custom Role.

<a id="nestedatt--permissions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `permissions`

Required:

- `rules` (Attributes List) The permission rules that make up the Custom Role. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permissions--rules))

Optional:

- `conditions` (Attributes List) Additional constraints that apply to the whole permission set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permissions--conditions))

<a id="nestedatt--permissions--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `permissions.rules`

Required:

- `permissions` (List of String) The actions this rule allows.
- `type` (String) The rule type.

Optional:

- `caches` (Attributes) Which caches this rule applies to. Exactly one of `all` or `name` must be set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permissions--rules--caches))
- `databases` (Attributes) Which databases this rule applies to. Exactly one of `all` or `name` must be set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permissions--rules--databases))
- `functions` (Attributes) Which functions this rule applies to. Exactly one of `all`, `name`, or `prefix` must be set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permissions--rules--functions))
- `items` (Attributes) Which items this rule applies to. Exactly one of `all`, `key`, or `key_prefix` must be set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permissions--rules--items))
- `resources` (Attributes) Which resources this rule applies to. Must be `all`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permissions--rules--resources))
- `stores` (Attributes) Which stores this rule applies to. Exactly one of `all` or `name` must be set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permissions--rules--stores))
- `topics` (Attributes) Which topics this rule applies to. Exactly one of `all`, `name`, or `prefix` must be set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permissions--rules--topics))

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Custom roles can be imported by specifying their ID,
# which you can find via the Momento CLI:
momento role list
terraform import momento_custom_role.example r-abcdefg

# To import by role name instead, use an `import` block with the `identity` argument.
```
